note: TLS 1.3 loopback harness listener and the UDS Harness Profile socket (CP-02, mode 0660, newline-delimited JSON-RPC, peer UID plus a bearer key hashed with Argon2id, smcpctl uds key), POST-only MCP endpoint, header and body bounds, Host and Origin checks, CP-09 connection and unauthenticated-work limits (QUEUE_FULL before the body is read), per-source rate limits and lockout with bounded source tables (IPv6 counted per /64). The Remote Access listener (internal/remote) adds CP-49 bounds, the public-name Host check and per-client limits, and follows listener certificate rotation. Requirement report: 18 of 31 verified; partial FR-9.17, FR-11.5 (perf job on CI runners, not reference hardware), FR-12.2, FR-16.1, FR-16.2, FR-16.6. Missing: nftables rules on remote enable (SR-4.14-1); FR-12.1 and FR-12.8 need an inspection of the release SBOM and provenance bundle. Deferred from 1.0 (SRS Appendix N): the mTLS Harness Profile.

Both protocol eras through the MCP Go SDK in stateless mode, method allowlist, -32600 for batches and 202 for unknown notifications, cache hints, HMAC-protected pagination cursors, trace context and clientInfo capture, Appendix B codes with reasonCode, correlationId, decisionId and the data.message text, hold-mode keep-alives, listen streams bounded per session (CP-20) and in total with write deadlines, list_changed after policy activation and server suspension. Backend progress is relayed with the northbound token at most 10 per second per request (CP-21), each message through the response filters. Server-initiated requests other than ping get -32601 and an InputRequiredResult maps to -31010. The FR-12.9 conformance suite (internal/conformance) drives a complete Gateway with the mcp-spec examples and validates every message against schema.json. Requirement report: 41 of 43 verified; partial FR-1.51 (not every code triggered end to end) and SR-2-1. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): the MRTR Relay Profile.

OAuth 2.1 authorization server (metadata, PKCE S256, resource, iss), pre-registered clients, Client ID Metadata Documents fetched only for CP-52 allowlisted URLs, sign-in by Session Approver accounts only (the Administrator is refused), Argon2id, rate limits, lockout with backoff and dummy verification; a second redemption of an authorization code ends the session the first created. Principals, OAuth client credentials and Session Approver accounts created from the control API (internal/principals, G-11) are found next to those of smcp.toml; revocations and suspensions run under the Enforcement Coordinator's gate. UDS clients authenticate by kernel peer UID plus a bearer key (FR-2.15). Remote Access adds RFC 7591 registration with operator approval and per-source quotas, the RFC 8628 device grant and a cross-client Session Approver lockout. Requirement report: all 13 verified. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): mTLS client authentication.

Session store with CP-18 lifetimes, per-principal limits, scope-to-template mapping, harness type and version recorded at creation, baseline context key per session (FR-2.13), project-root claims narrowing path roots, session API, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, janitors that keep suspended sessions, per-session lifetime and allowed templates for remote sessions; operators suspend and resume sessions (FR-2.8). Session taint is tracked by the policy layer. Requirement report: 17 of 18 verified; partial FR-16.12. Sessions, taint, rate windows and quotas are in memory and end at a restart; survival across restarts (FR-2.16) is deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N).

Signed Policy Store (Ed25519, immutable revision files named by digest, signed active record with atomic activation), start-up import and fail-closed verification, publish with optional parent check, rollback as a new revision, diff, overlap analysis (SR-1.9-1), simulation from the journal or fixtures, /api/v1/policy* and smcpctl policy. Audit Profiles, Observation Policies and Anomaly Response Policies are published as numbered revisions by internal/obspolicy and Secret Use Policies by the Secret Broker; FR-3.1 names where each policy object type lives. Revocations, principal and server suspensions live outside the policy document and survive a policy rollback. Requirement report: 16 of 18 verified; partial SR-7.9-1 (no test suspends a server revision before an application rollback). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): draft workspaces (FR-3.3), Response Policy and Runtime Profile objects (FR-3.26), manifest ceiling checks at publication (SR-1-1).

Default-deny decisions with deny-rule precedence, argument predicates (FR-3.6), prerequisites, routes, approval floor by side-effect class (SR-1.18-1), restrict-only session taint, sliding-window rates with CP-11 burst, per-session quotas, CP-12 evaluation bounds, filter, secret-use, egress and runtime obligations (FR-3.12), profile and template intersection, the decision explanation route (SR-1.19-1), Diff and Simulate. A build tag smcp_broken produces a deliberately defective decider for the FR-15.8 broken-build check; release builds never set it. Requirement report: 21 of 22 verified; partial FR-11.2 (perf job: p95 well under the 10 ms budget on CI runners, not reference hardware). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): permits bound to revision IDs (SR-1.6-1).

Persisted one-use approvals bound per SR-1.18-2, re-approval after a transforming filter (SR-1.18-3), CP-17 expiry, hold mode with keep-alives and the -31002 fallback carrying approvalId, expiresAt and approvalUrl, Approver accounts, /api/v1/approvals* with a watch stream that ends when its token ends, the harness status route, smcpctl approvals, desktop notification, the G-13 view. Anomaly-band approvals carry the band, contributing feature, z-score, baseline snapshot and context, shown in G-13. Approval events of remote calls carry the remote origin fields. The real-agent suite holds and approves a call from each passing client, and a recorded Claude Code run covers the four FR-3.25 cases. Requirement report: 12 of 13 verified; partial FR-3.18 (the G-13 display is covered by an inspection record, not a test).

Session-scoped catalog per policy revision, updated in place on policy activation and server suspension with list_changed, unknown-tool rejection, approval hint (FR-1.50), metadata rule-set screen at presentation (FR-1.52), the gateway-admin class (SR-3.12-1), valid data: icons kept (SR-5.18-2), HMAC-protected pagination cursors. Requirement report: all 18 verified. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): manifest handle contracts (SR-2.12-1).

Ordered request chain with mandatory and policy-obliged filters, CP-14 deadline, panic as block: schema-validate (no external $ref; the CP-36 bound runs from the validator's start), size-limit, unicode-control, secret-fingerprint, path-canonicalize, url-canonicalize, injection-detect (tag only), the vault's secret-in-arguments filter, request scoring as the last filter; a transforming filter causes a second decision before launch (SR-5.12-1). Versioned rule sets with digests, a required-literal prefilter, and measured corpus rates published in the status data (FR-19.5). Requirement report: 15 of 16 verified; partial SR-5.8-1 (data-class rules beyond registered secrets).

stdio dispatch with CP-10 concurrency and queue bounds, CP-13 upstream timeout, bounded result reading, backend error mapping, cancellation propagated to the backend with notifications/cancelled (FR-5.26), suspension of a server on drift. No client capability is declared southbound; server-initiated requests other than ping are refused with -32601 and an InputRequiredResult with -31010. Backend progress travels on a Gateway-issued token. An instance that times out or fails is replaced; the third unexpected exit within five minutes suspends the revision (FR-5.12). When dispatching to an instance attached to the Egress Broker it delivers the call's one-use egress capabilities in _meta. Requirement report: 21 of 22 verified (FR-5, the parent, waits on its children). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): per-session and per-call instances, the modern-era southbound probe and requests (FR-5.16 to FR-5.18) and southbound Streamable HTTP (FR-5.28 to FR-5.31).

Response chain: size-limit (size and depth), output-schema, content-type-gate, secret-fingerprint (redact or withhold with SECRET_LEAK), unicode-control, pii-detect, injection-marker, delimit-untrusted (FR-4.18), the vault's leak filter, response scoring as the last filter; provenance with disposition and tags; every malformed result envelope is refused (SR-5.20-1). Relayed progress messages pass the same chain. Requirement report: all 10 verified.

One-use launch capability bound to correlation, decision, policy revision and tool; pre-launch and pre-release rechecks under the coordinator's gate, which also serializes credential revocation, principal suspension and server revision suspension (SR-1.16-1) and rechecks principal, credential and revision state at launch (SR-1.17-1); authorized committed with fsync before the capability and delivered before release; emergency stop cancels calls in flight and a drain stop lets them finish for backups (SR-7.7-1); the health gate refuses calls. A failed journal write refuses the call with JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE. Requirement report: 13 of 15 verified; partial SR-6.2-1 (the journal commit is the authority, not one transaction with the graph links). External: SR-4.1-1 (CP-46 service identities on a running Enforced host not inspected).

Recipes, package build (npm, PyPI, OCI or binary by digest, locked dependency closure, live probe, Appendix J manifest), minisign signing and offline verification, trust anchors scoped to risk classes with fingerprint confirmation, revocation entries and the revocation feed with a staleness block (SR-3-4), library scan and import with receipts, artifact re-verification before every launch, egress grants checked against the manifest's declared capabilities (EGRESS_EXCEEDS_MANIFEST); bootstrap packages the reference server; reference packages for filesystem, git, fetch and memory are built, signed, imported and called by the reference-packages workflow. Requirement report: 17 of 25 verified; partial FR-14.1, FR-14.3 (OCI images are not probed without Podman), FR-14.5, FR-14.9, SR-3.5-1 (probe network isolation needs a confining launcher), SR-5.9-2. External: FR-18.6 (nobody has followed the packaging guide for a non-reference server).

Content-addressed artifact store, directory library (FR-5.1), immutable revisions and registry states, enablement checks (Standalone refuses high risk, alias uniqueness, expiry), operator classification overrides (SR-3.11-1), drift detection at start and on list_changed that suspends the revision, /api/v1/packages, smcpctl package and the G-10 view (enable, suspend, retire). A tool-name collision disables only the colliding revision. A revision enabled while smcpd runs is launched at the next start. Requirement report: all 13 verified. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): era consistency at start (FR-5.17).

Launch specification from configuration and enabled package revisions, rootless Podman launcher (Enforced, optionally as the CP-46 identity smcp-srv) and subprocess launcher (Standalone), environment allowlist, bounded stderr with delivered secret values redacted, FR-5.27 shutdown sequence, reaping of leftover containers, relaunch of failed instances with a crash-loop threshold. Requirement report: 5 of 9 verified; partial FR-5.37 (endpoint variables from configuration, not signed manifests), FR-12.3, SR-2.14-1, SR-3.6-1 (unpackaged servers allowed unless [packages] require_signed). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): per-session and per-call instance scopes and idle teardown (FR-5.10, FR-5.11).

Rootless Podman with read-only root, no capabilities, no-new-privileges, default seccomp, a distinct user namespace per instance, private namespaces, CP-24 cgroup limits with delegated controllers, size-bounded tmpfs, grant-only mounts. network = egress attaches the instance to the Egress Broker on slirp4netns with nftables in its namespace allowing only TCP to its broker listeners. S2 and S3 secret files are mounted read-only at /smcp/secrets with POSIX ACL entries for the instance UID. packaging/linux installs the CP-46 identities including smcp-srv, nftables, systemd units and the AppArmor profiles smcpd and smcp-server (enforce mode); CI runs smcpd.service under real systemd with sandboxed tool calls and checks the server profile. Requirement report: all 5 partial: SR-4.1-2, SR-4.5-1, SR-4.6-1 (mount intersection with manifest and policy roots), SR-4.7-1, SR-4.7-2 (each checks the requested configuration and a real container in CI, short of the full verification statement). The smcp-server profile covers image-less servers only; no SELinux module ships.

Runtime Monitor: cgroup sampling and inotify on memory and PID events, podman events, process creation evaluated against the manifest's declared behavior (FR-5.34), deviation (UNDECLARED_PROCESS, EXEC_INTO_INSTANCE), limit_breach, instance_killed and instance_exited evidence, alert and kill-instance actions; revisions are suspended by the crash-loop threshold. Requirement report: all 3 verified. File opens outside mounts and network attempts are prevented, not observed (FR-5.33 leaves them out).

Per-instance forward proxy (CONNECT with SNI check, plain HTTP), per-destination TLS-originating endpoints, grants by host, port, method and class, one-use capabilities per call (SR-5.16-1, Smcp-Egress-Auth), broker DNS with optional resolvers and rebinding defense, reserved-address refusal, redirect checks, outbound secret-fingerprint scan (SR-5.8-2, EGRESS_SECRET_DETECTED), size, duration and rate limits, public-fetch profile, egress evidence naming the call, /api/v1/egress and smcpctl egress. Enforced for sandboxed servers; advisory proxy variables in Standalone. AT-10 is claimed by TestAT10WebBroker. Requirement report: 8 of 9 verified; partial FR-5.38 (grants and limits from configuration, not policy obligations or Runtime Profiles).

Age-encrypted versioned vault, master key in the macOS Keychain or passphrase-wrapped (SR-2.13-1), owner-only file modes, rotation with CP-15 overlap and retirement, smcpctl secrets and /api/v1/secrets (metadata only). Requirement report: 6 of 8 verified; partial FR-6 and SR-2.13-3 (separate service identities for vault and broker). No vault health check is registered (FR-7.11). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): TPM key sealing.

Secret Use Policy file, S1 header injection through the Egress Broker (also for sandboxed servers with network = egress), S2 per-call files, S3 per-instance files (mounted read-only into the sandbox), S4 environment with waiver, secret_use evidence without values naming the secret on early denials, HMAC leak fingerprints for the filters and the Egress Broker, leak suspension and resume, withdrawal on emergency stop and when a launch is refused (LAUNCH_FAILED), secret bindings in the permission report. Requirement report: 2 of 7 verified; partial FR-6.6, FR-6.7 (no tmpfs on macOS), FR-6.8, FR-6.10. Missing: SR-2.13-2 (S4 environment delivery and string conversions keep copies that cannot be overwritten). Launch-time deliveries are not withdrawn at session end because instances are not session-scoped.

Signed hash-chained JSON Lines journal with group-committed fsync, crash recovery, signed anchor, verifier that follows evidence-key transitions and counts unsigned open events, evidence export of closed segments whose anchor only moves forward, CP-27 unsigned-age rule, CP-26 storage quota, purge receipts, non-blocking observers feeding the graph mirror and observation. A failed write fails the endpoint closed. Requirement report: 15 of 21 verified; partial FR-16.8, SR-6.1-1, SR-6.7-1, SR-6.10-1. External: SR-6.12-1 (key custody depends on the Enforced installation's identities). Anchor rollback with segment deletion is detectable only with an off-host export (RR-08); the journal has no index for queries (FR-11.8).

CP-53 server CA (365 days, path length 0, dNSName constraints) and listener certificate (90 days, renewed at 30), hot reload on every listener including the remote one, CA rotation with overlap, evidence-key rotation with signed transition, policy-signing key, package trust anchors, operator token, installation ID, UDS bearer keys; smcpd refuses to start when the operator token or a private key file is readable by group or others, and warns when an older CA still has iPAddress constraints. FR-7.8 lists the key purposes release 1.0 has, verified by inspection. Requirement report: 7 of 8 verified; partial FR-17.7 (a client trusting only the incoming CA connects after the switch, not during the overlap). Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): the client CA (FR-7.15) and TPM or Keychain sealing of private keys (FR-7.9).

Health and Safety Monitor with one-second checks, fail-closed latch with 10 s recovery and acknowledgment of integrity causes, edge gate, health of the graph mirror, Observation Store, observation degradation, revocation feed and storage quotas, loopback Prometheus metrics with a Host check, rotating redacted diagnostic log with call tracing at debug, configuration reload of the CP-50 keys, profile decision with the not-enforced label. Listeners are bound before anything else opens a socket. Requirement report: 9 of 13 verified; partial FR-7.11 (no vault check), FR-13.13 (only one configuration version exists), FR-17.3.

smcpctl covers bootstrap, install, configuration, journal, policy, approvals, approvers, packages, trust, filters, secrets, egress, runtime, graph, observe, keys, uds, backup, restore, upgrade (verified minisign release), uninstall, remote, clients, lockdown and doctor. Control API with every Appendix C role from one route matrix, per-object If-Match revisions (SR-8.9-1) and GET /api/v1/openapi.json describing every route (rendered on the project site). Embedded React console with views G-01 to G-14 under a strict CSP: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie sessions with a CSRF token, inert rendering of hostile evidence (AT-07), per-field help, keyboard-only flows for every view and axe WCAG 2.2 AA checks in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Releases: install.sh with minisign and Sigstore checks, Homebrew tap, SBOM per archive, release label from the acceptance results; v1.0.0-rc.1 and rc.2 published. Requirement report: 26 of 73 verified, 42 partial. External or unverified: FR-8.24 (timed first-time-user task), FR-13.3 (tap install is a CI workflow, record FR-13.3.md), FR-8.30 (two latest releases of each browser), FR-11.8 (analytics queries over 30 days, reference hardware). The view requirements FR-8.4 to FR-8.17 have partial Playwright claims without Demonstration records; keyboard flows skip G-10 suspend and enable, G-08 key rotation and graph rebuild, G-01 health acknowledgement, instance kill and export downloads.

Neo4j Community Edition 2026.05.0 integration, disabled unless [graph] enabled: ordered migrations with uniqueness constraints for every Appendix D label, engine settings and heap checks against CP-33, a health check that reports degraded and never fail-closed, smcpctl graph config. Requirement report: 3 of 7 verified; partial FR-9, FR-9.1 (relationship types of other elements), SR-4.2-1 and SR-7.4-1 (no nftables rules for the engine port or outbound denial).

Data Access Service with a digest-checked template catalog, declared and bound parameters, server-side timeouts; the evidence mirror is an idempotent audit observer with journal catch-up and rebuild; /api/v1/graph* and canned queries. Observation batching and backpressure (FR-9.5, FR-9.6) are verified. Requirement report: all 8 verified. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): write priority classes (FR-9.4) and peer credentials of the Data Access Service (SR-4.3-1).

Observation Store tables partitioned by UTC day with one column per catalog parameter and a spans table, write-once batches of at most 1,000 rows or 200 ms on a low-priority writer, DuckDB with zstd Parquet (cgo builds) or JSON Lines (release archives), aggregate queries with parity between backends, CP-25 retention, storage quota with a health warning at 80%, a published memory budget (G-08). Requirement report: 3 of 5 verified; partial FR-11.6 and SR-4.2-2. Release archives built without cgo have no Parquet. Deferred from 1.0 (Appendix N): storage tiering (FR-9.13).

Graph retention in bounded batches, heap sampling with pressure flag, DuckDB memory limit, degradation stages under memory or queue pressure in a fixed order (FR-9.12), observation and research dataset retention, encrypted online backup after a drain, scheduled backups (FR-9.16) and verified restore that re-applies suspensions and revocations (smcpctl backup, restore). Requirement report: 5 of 12 verified; partial FR-9.10, FR-9.11, FR-11.9 (idle RSS measured on CI runners), SR-6.14-1, SR-7.7-1, SR-7.8-1 (no graph dump in backups, the mirror is not rebuilt on restore). External: FR-12.4 (CP-46 directories on installed hosts not inspected).

Observation Collector as an audit observer plus mandatory probes run inline on the call's goroutine: one record per call with the computed catalog parameters, deterministic sampling, capture escalation, scope by principal, framework type, template, server and tool, drop counting, meta-metrics, per-stage and per-filter spans with thread CPU time (FR-10.2); batched queue taken every 10 ms; never blocks a call. Published Observation Policies apply at once, baseline contexts at the next start. Requirement report: 7 of 14 verified; partial FR-10, FR-10.1, FR-10.2, FR-10.5, FR-10.8, FR-10.10 and FR-11.4 (0.42 ms p95 difference with observation enabled in the CI job perf at ee2e851, budget 1 ms; CI runners are not reference hardware). Missing: S3 payload capture and first-N-per-session capture.

Welford statistics with optional decay, log1p and Box-Cox transforms, t-digest median and MAD, category and transition surprise, learning exclusions, sealed snapshots, drift reports, promotion and rollback, integrity events. Baseline contexts and bands come from the published Observation Policy, with a baseline context key per session (FR-2.13). Requirement report: all 11 verified.

Digest-verified atomic snapshot load, z and robust z with sigma floors, max-|z| combination naming the feature, CP-30 bands and uncharacterized, asynchronous alerts and capture escalation, optional synchronous approval and withhold obligations (off by default) as the last filters of the chains, per-band actions from the published Anomaly Response Policy (restrict-only, alert-only bands, the uncharacterized state maps to record, escalate or approve), anomaly evidence on the approval record. Requirement report: all 10 verified.

Campaign life cycle with clocks and quota, exports in Parquet, CSV, JSON Lines and GraphML with per-dataset HMAC pseudonyms, dictionary, manifest and checksums, CSV formula neutralization, export files opened inside their root, retention that deletes datasets and their keys (FR-9.14). Researcher accounts create, submit and stop campaigns and export their datasets. Requirement report: 8 of 9 verified; partial FR-10.34 (no Parquet in builds without cgo).

smcp-session, smcp-stdio (both eras, UDS dialing) and smcp-connect (binary and npm) with the CP-43 credential file; smcpctl clients setup, lockdown and doctor for the seven local clients; Tailscale Funnel and Cloudflare tunnel drivers. The real-agent suite passes Claude Code, Codex CLI, Hermes Agent, OpenCode and Goose on every scenario, and its broken-build check turns a client to fail against a deliberately broken smcpd. Gemini CLI is not run (no GEMINI_API_KEY) and Grok Build is not run (no public CLI). Requirement report: 5 of 20 verified, 11 partial (setup and lockdown at pinned versions, FR-15.8, adapters). Missing: dated cloud-agent runs for Grok Bot, the ChatGPT agent and Meta Muse (FR-15.9), confirmed vendor allowlist settings (FR-16.10). External: FR-18.3 (quick starts not followed at the pinned version for every client).
